New releases by artists in your library, found on MusicBrainz about once a day. Sends their names and MusicBrainz IDs to musicbrainz.org and loads covers from coverartarchive.org. Your server address, credentials and headers are never shared.

maekster can send what you play to ListenBrainz, an open listening history from the MetaBrainz Foundation. A listen is sent once a song passes the scrobble point.
If your music server already sends listens to ListenBrainz, leave this off to avoid duplicates.
Find your token on listenbrainz.org under Settings, User token.
